 Arkansas football vs. No. 23 Missouri: How to watch and listen, forecast, betting line
 October 30, 2026 at 2:04 p.m.
 by 
 Matt Jones 
 The Battle Line Rivalry Trophy is shown during a game between Arkansas and Missouri on Friday, Nov. 25, 2022, in Columbia, Mo. (Hank Layton/WholeHogSports) 
 SCHEDULED GAME TIME 
 Saturday at 6:45 p.m. at Reynolds Razorback Stadium (76,412) in Fayetteville 
 RECORDS  
 Arkansas: 3-4, 1-3 SEC
 Missouri: 5-2, 2-2 SEC
 STREAKS 
 Arkansas: Won 1
 Missouri: Lost 1
 COACHES  
 Arkansas: Ryan Silverfield — 3-4 in first season at Arkansas and 53-29 in seventh season overall. 
 Missouri: Eli Drinkwitz — 51-31 in seventh season at Missouri and 63-32 in eighth season overall. 
 SERIES  HISTORY 
 Missouri leads 12-4
 LAST MEETING 
 Missouri defeated Arkansas 31-17 on Nov. 29, 2025, in Fayetteville. 
 TELEVISION  
 The game will be televised by SEC Network and can be accessed on WatchESPN.com and via the ESPN app (subscriber login required). Dave Neal (play-by-play), Cole Cubelic (analyst) and Tori Petry (sideline) will be on the call.
 RADIO  
 Chuck Barrett (play-by-play), Quinn Grovey (analyst) and Geno Bell (sideline) will call the game on the Razorback Sports Network, which can be accessed through local FM and AM affiliates , via the Arkansas Razorbacks Gameday app, via the Varsity Network app or on ArkansasRazorbacks.com. Blackouts may apply. 
 FORECAST 
 According to the National Weather Service, Saturday night will be cloudy with a 50% chance of showers in Fayetteville. The high will be 71 degrees and the low 55. Southeast winds will be calm.
 BETTING LINE 
 Missouri is a 9.5-point favorite, according to FanDuel.
 NOTABLE 
 • Missouri has won the last four games in the series against Arkansas, including back-to-back games in Fayetteville by scores of 48-14 in 2023 and 31-17 last season. The Tigers have a 10-2 record in the series as SEC opponents. 
 • Eli Drinkwitz has a 5-1 record against Arkansas as Missouri's coach. Drinkwitz grew up in Alma, about 45 miles south of Fayetteville. 
 • Arkansas coach Ryan Silverfield coached against Drinkwitz in 2023 when Missouri defeated Silverfield's Memphis team by a score of 34-27 in St. Louis. 
 • Missouri running back Ahmad Hardy is expected to play Saturday for the first time this season. Hardy, who was a Doak Walker Award finalist last year, was shot in the leg at a concert in Mississippi in May. 
 • Arkansas receiver Chris Marshall is questionable for the game. Marshall ranks third in the SEC in receiving yards per game and fourth in receptions. 
 • Mizzou is 1-2 on the road this season. The Tigers won 38-21 at Kansas on Sept. 11, lost 31-24 at Mississippi State on Sept. 26, and lost 31-3 at Ole Miss on Oct. 17.
 • Arkansas is 2-2 at home, with wins over North Alabama (31-14) and Tulsa (34-6), and losses to Georgia (45-17) and Tennessee (24-17). The Razorbacks have lost their last 10 home games against Power 4 teams dating to October 2024.
